summary: SCIM was first designed for provisioning user accounts. This Standards Track document adds schema extensions so SCIM can also provision devices. It covers several onboarding systems, including Wi-Fi Easy Connect, FIDO device onboarding vouchers, Bluetooth Low Energy passcodes, and MAC Authenticated Bypass.

eli5.summary: School keeps a list of students. This adds a list of gadgets too, so the school can record each one and how it should get connected.
